instruction: Propose a restricted reusable mapping. Inspect the helper implementation. No application names, paths, executable extensions, or certifications. Return mapping JSON only. Use schema 2. For this bounded increase family require parameters 1 and 2 constant, amount > 0, maximum >= 0. Preserve the exact matcher implementation. Use provenance mode live, provider OpenAI Codex CLI, model gpt-6-sol, liveDiscovery true. An identical expression lowering is valid.

diagnostic.message: No accepted mapping for this helper implementation; run discover explicitly

mappingSchema.description: Inert reusable pure numeric function mapping. Exact required root fields below; no executable extensions.

matcher.body: Expression tree. A function has one return or expression arrow, numeric parameters, no effects, captures, defaults, rest, types or async.

expression.types: arithmetic and comparisons take numbers; boolean operations take booleans; select takes boolean then equal-typed alternatives

preconditions.constantParameters: array of unique parameter indices required to be compile-time constants
preconditions.predicates: array of boolean expression trees over parameters

mappingSchema.lowering: An expression tree of the same result type as matcher.body. Identical lowering is permitted; validation establishes exact bounded semantics.
mappingSchema.capabilities: Exactly the sorted distinct operation names used in lowering, prefixed integer- for numeric results and boolean- for boolean results, e.g. integer-add and integer-min. Leaves have no capability.

provenance.liveDiscovery: boolean (a claim, independently recorded invocation required)

tests.negative: array of {args:[values],reason:optional string} violating numeric domain or predicates

mappingSchema.validation: Compiler-owned JavaScript oracle, structural/numeric corpus, exact reachable application closure. Proposal tests supplemental. Candidate <=64KiB. Max64 tests in each list. No naming/path assumptions.

contractReminders: version must be a positive integer, not a semantic version string

Every original arithmetic intermediate must satisfy abs <= 1000000. Positive/boundary tests exceeding this are invalid even if min clamps the result. Negative tests may describe this domain violation.
